description:
Create or upsert a 0nFlow — a reusable scheduled workflow that runs
across time. Each flow is a sequence of steps (email, sms, slack, tag_add,
webhook, wait). Once created, contacts can be enrolled with flow_enroll
and the cron drains them on schedule.

Steps support {{contact.x}} template variables, e.g.:
  { "action": "email",
    "params": { "subject": "Hi {{contact.email}}", "body": "Score: {{contact.score}}" },
    "delay_seconds": 60 }

Example:
  flow_create({
    slug: "sxo-free-scan-nurture",
    name: "SXO Free Scan Nurture",
    owner_product: "sxowebsite",
    default_provider: "crm",
    default_location_id: "AeY8M0GNOuJPNkLQ7AAC",
    steps: [
      { action: "email", params: { subject: "Your score: {{contact.score}}/100", body: "..." }, delay_seconds: 60 },
      { action: "wait", params: {}, delay_seconds: 172800 },
      { action: "email", params: { subject: "4.88 fix plan for {{contact.domain}}", body: "..." } },
      { action: "tag_add", params: { tags: ["sxo-nurture-completed"] }, delay_seconds: 432000 }
    ]
  })

slug.description: Stable identifier, used by enroll. Lowercase, hyphenated.

steps.description: Ordered list of steps to execute

name: flow_create
